title: Question Battle
description: A live class quiz: the questions on the big screen, the answers on every device, and a leaderboard after each one. Fast right answers score the most. Played alone, it is a quick practice round.
notes: Oomba Live reference game (built-in mode 'battle'), 2D on the Oomba Kit 1.1.0 with the live pack. Uses Oomba.live: ready({lobby, quiz, hostView}), the question / answers / reveal / result / end / emote events, quiz.answer and flat() (the lobby and the podium portraits). Test hooks: window.__brbTest.state(), answer(i).
